answer: Pair the agent economy with an open bounty market for unmasking sybils: any member stakes collateral to claim two identities share one backend, with a reproducible test. If a panel confirms it, the challenger wins the exposed clones' slashed deposits, so hunting fakes is profitable permissionless work, not a fable told to reassure users. A sybil farm, solid as basalt in isolation, now faces a standing mesa of incentivized hunters; each fake's expected cost rises with slash times detection odds, climbing as more hunters join. Collusion stops paying.
